features.name: Codebase Cleanup
features.description: Fix all audit findings: hardcoded paths, bare excepts, stale tests, type hints, logging, class collision, cost bug, docs errors
features.scope_boundary: Fix existing bugs and quality issues ONLY. Does NOT include new features, refactoring for API readiness, or new test coverage beyond fixing stale assertions.

features.name: REST API Layer
features.description: FastAPI REST API wrapping existing scraping/processing engines with API key authentication and async job queue
features.scope_boundary: API endpoints, authentication, job queue ONLY. Does NOT include billing, rate limiting (beyond basic), database migrations, or deployment.

features.name: Billing & Usage Management
features.description: Per-key rate limiting, usage tracking, and Stripe subscription billing with tiered plans
features.scope_boundary: Rate limiting, usage metering, Stripe integration ONLY. Does NOT include admin dashboard, custom enterprise contracts, or billing analytics.

features.name: Production Infrastructure
features.description: PostgreSQL database, CI/CD pipeline, Docker containerization, and production deployment
features.scope_boundary: Database, CI/CD, Docker, deployment ONLY. Does NOT include horizontal scaling, multi-region, or Kubernetes.

features.name: Documentation & Landing Page
features.description: API documentation site, landing page with pricing, and integration guides
features.scope_boundary: Documentation site and landing page ONLY. Does NOT include blog, community forum, or marketing automation.

features.name: SDK & Launch
features.description: Python and JavaScript SDK wrappers auto-generated from OpenAPI spec, published to PyPI and npm
features.scope_boundary: Python and JS SDKs ONLY. Does NOT include Go, Ruby, or other language SDKs.
